goals.objective: Complete FrameTrace production continuation in sequence: classify the dirty worktree into atomic verified work units; rerun and preserve current evidence; verify and commit each executable safe unit; run full validation and real-surface CLI/browser evidence for GUI inventory, SQLite inventory query, media validation, audit/report, and Windows prerequisite release gating; continue until all executable macOS-compatible work is complete or until the true blocker is Windows-only WinUI build/test execution. Do not claim Windows or WinUI GA from macOS, do not fake ULW/Codex completion snapshots, and preserve original evidence paths as read-only.
